title: Daily Dose RPG: a short daily roguelike story you can play in the browser. Looking for playtesters
author: Chemical-Sign-203
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/0s2sth4bkuwh1.png

I've been building **Daily Dose RPG**: short, replayable roguelike stories you play in one sitting. At the end you get a score and a rank. It's a mash-up of my favorite kinds of games: the loot and gear cards of Munchkin, the point-and-click searching of King's Quest, and the turn-based fights of classic Final Fantasy. Think of it as a quick daily habit, like Wordle, but with a story.  
  
The first story, The Thirteenth Bell, is up to play. A bellringer climbed his tower and never came down. Now the bell rings thirteen times at night. You pick a class (there are 7), search a village and a church for clues, fight what you find, and work out what's in the belfry.  
  
**How it was made:** I built it with Claude Code. The pixel art is drawn in code and the music is composed in code too, so there are no image generators and no stock assets. I directed the design, the writing voice and the balance. Yes, the pixel art has the "Claude look". Making it my own is on the list.  
  
**Play it:** https://dailydoserpg.com.   
It's free with no sign-up, and it works on phone and desktop. A run takes about 10-15 minutes.  
  
**What I'd love to know:**

\- Did you finish a run? If you quit, where and why?

\- Where did you get confused or stuck?

\- Which part was the most fun, and which was the most boring?

\- Any bugs. A screenshot and your device help a lot.

Post your runs in the thread! Hit Share at the end and paste your card.  
  
It's a proof of concept, so be honest. The rough parts are what I'm trying to find.

Thanks in advance!
